in_sanskrit.name: निर्मित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who shapes or forms, molder, artisan, craftsman

in_marathi.name: Nirmit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Creator, Maker, Craftsman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nirmit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nirmit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir-mit,' which means 'not-sent' or 'self-manifested.' In Hindu mythology, Nirmit is a name for the divine architect, Vishwakarma, who created the universe. It is a name for one who creates or makes things, a craftsman, an artist, or a builder.
